title: Attribute Selector
body:
Matches on an attribute rather than on a tag, class, or id. Written in square brackets.

```css
input[type=text]      { ... }   /* has that exact value */
a[href]               { ... }   /* has the attribute at all */
a[href^="https"]      { ... }   /* value starts with */
img[alt$=".png"]      { ... }   /* value ends with */
```

Useful for form controls, since [[Input Tag]] elements differ by `type` rather than by class.
See [[CSS Selectors]].
